title: Ayran And Yogurt
description: A specialized Minecraft mod that adds refreshing Ayran and delicious Yogurt items to your game
body:
Ayran and Yogurt Mod

Welcome to the Ayran and Yogurt Mod! This mod brings the most refreshing and traditional dairy products to the world of Minecraft. If you are tired of the same old food sources, it’s time to add some cultural flavor to your journey!
